runs.title_zh: Weekly #6 · Fault Capability / Reset Reconciliation / FW Shared Memory
runs.title_en: Weekly #6 · Fault Capability / Reset Reconciliation / FW Shared Memory
runs.intro_zh: 七大 Owner 不变。本期把 VM faultability、reset 后 ring/fence/FW state reconciliation、FW shared-memory ownership 提升为显式 contract；Memory reclaim 继续作为 P1。
runs.intro_en: The seven-owner taxonomy stays unchanged. This run promotes VM faultability, post-reset ring/fence/FW reconciliation and FW shared-memory ownership into explicit contracts while keeping Memory reclaim as P1.

highlights.body_zh: faultable/scratch/replay/PASID binding 成为显式 VM/context 属性，fault handler 先验证 capability 再进入 HMM/migration/replay。
highlights.body_en: Make faultable/scratch/replay/PASID binding explicit VM/context properties and validate them before HMM/migration/replay.

highlights.body_zh: KIQ reset fence 案例表明 reset 完成不等于软件世界恢复；逐对象定义 state survival、sequence realignment、stale completion 与 validation。
highlights.body_en: The KIQ reset-fence case shows reset completion is not software recovery; define state survival, sequence realignment, stale completions and validation per object.

highlights.title_zh: Firmware：MappedBo 统一 CPU/GPU mapping lifetime
highlights.title_en: Firmware: MappedBo unifies CPU/GPU mapping lifetime
highlights.body_zh: Tyr 把 persistent CPU vmap 与 KernelBo/GPU mapping 绑定，为 FW-reported address bounds validation 建立自然 ownership boundary。
highlights.body_en: Tyr binds persistent CPU vmap to KernelBo/GPU mapping, creating a natural ownership boundary for validating FW-reported addresses.

runs.title_zh: Weekly #5 · VRAM Reclaim / Recovery Escalation / Structured RAS
runs.title_en: Weekly #5 · VRAM Reclaim / Recovery Escalation / Structured RAS
runs.intro_zh: Memory 保持 recoverable fault/HMM 为 P0，并把 VRAM Pressure + Reclaim/Eviction 提升为 P1；RAS 扩展到 Recovery Scope + Escalation。
runs.intro_en: Memory keeps recoverable fault/HMM as P0 and promotes VRAM Pressure + Reclaim/Eviction to P1; RAS expands into Recovery Scope + Escalation.

runs.title_zh: Weekly #4 · Recovery Contract / VFIO AER / Telemetry Service
runs.title_en: Weekly #4 · Recovery Contract / VFIO AER / Telemetry Service
runs.intro_zh: RAS 深化为 Recovery Admission / State / Sequence Contract。
runs.intro_en: RAS deepens into a Recovery Admission / State / Sequence Contract.
